title: Quietly Toasted Japanese Noodles Zenzai
description: A traditional Japanese dish from the Shikoku region, featuring flat rice noodles and toast in a romantic zenzai style, perfect for a quiet evening in. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly dish is both earthy and aerated.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and cook the flat rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Toast the whole wheat bread slices until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg and set aside.
Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the sliced mushrooms until tender.
Add the chopped green onions to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the mushrooms and green onions.
Pour the whisked egg over the noodles and stir gently to distribute.
Season with soy sauce and salt to taste.
Place the toasted bread slices on a raclette grill and top with the noodle mixture.
